summary_en: ¥2.00 per share final dividend for FY6/26 (record date 2026-06-30, effective 2026-09-28). First dividend resumption since prior-year zero payout. Funded from retained earnings. Management targets consolidated payout ratio of approximately 20% going forward, balancing shareholder returns with R&D investment and business recovery priorities.
title_en: (Corrected) Notice of Partial Correction to 'Notice Regarding Final Dividend (Dividend Resumption)'
translation_en_brief: This disclosure is a correction notice to an earlier announcement of dividend resumption. The company is restoring a final dividend of ¥2.00 per share for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 (record date 2026-06-30, effective date 2026-09-28), funded from retained earnings. This marks the first dividend payment since the prior year (FY6/25), when no dividend was paid. The correction updates the document to clarify that the prior-period dividend was zero and adds management's stated policy that a consolidated payout ratio target of approximately 20% will guide future dividend decisions, balancing capital returns to shareholders against retained earnings deployed for R&D activities and the ongoing final phase of business recovery.
